onChange.script:
system.perspective.print("data change origin %s"%origin)
	if origin == 'BindingWriteback':	
		data = self.custom.lotOperationEventInfo.selection.data
		self.custom.lotOperationEventInfo.lotOperationEventId = None if len(data) == 0 else data[0]['lotOperationEventId']
		
	return

transforms.code:
secConfig = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.security.getConfig({}), 'configName', 'configValue')
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(value['user'])	
	userCRUD = system.kanoa.security.getUserAssetCRUD(userId)
	
	return {"userId": userId, "config": secConfig, "userCRUD": userCRUD}

if value is None: return ''
	return 'Lot #%s - %s '%(value['lotName'], system.kanoa.utilities.formatPath(value['itemPath'], {}))

config.script:
lotOperationName = self.view.custom.lotOperationEventInfo.selection.data[0].lotOperationName
	msg = "Are you sure you want to delete lot operation %s? This will remove all lot events associated with this lot operation"%lotOperationName
	system.perspective.openPopup("UserConfirmPopup", "kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm",  {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteLotOperationMsg'}, title='Delete Lot', draggable=True, overlayDismiss=True, showCloseIcon=True)

#	self.view.getChild("root").deleteLotOperation()
	
	return

system.perspective.openPopup('lotOperationEditor', 'kanoa/mes/lots/lotOperationEditor', {'value': {"lotOperationEventId": None, "lotOperationId": None, "lotId": self.view.custom.lotInfo.lotId}}, title = 'Lot Operation Editor', resizable=True, draggable=True, closable=True)
	
	return

transforms.code:
data = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(value)
	lotOperationEventIds = []
	rows = []
	for row in data:
		if row['lotOperationEventId'] and row['lotOperationEventId'] not in lotOperationEventIds:
			rows.append(row)
			lotOperationEventIds.append(row['lotOperationEventId'])
	
	return rows

customMethods.name: deleteLotOperationEvent
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print('deleteLotOperationEvent() called')
	lotOperationEventId = self.view.custom.lotOperationEventInfo.selection.data[0].lotOperationEventId
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.lot.deleteLotOperationEvent(lotOperationEventId, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Lot Operation could not be deleted. %s'%msg})
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Lot Operation has been deleted'})	

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.lotOperationEventInfo.data")
	
	return
